reviews.x: I’m really not sure why some of the reviews says it’s not meant for acrylic application. I was skeptical about getting it, but I’m glad I did! It’s amazingggggg.. my acrylic application has improved so much since using it.. sometimes I forget to clean it & it still works wonderful, just clean it directly after usage.. it’s chipping a little where the heart is, but that’s not a huge issue. I think it’s a #8 though, this is the brush compared to a size #5 brush, but this is GREAT for beginners & p
I just love this brush. I'm a beginner and it makes the acrylic application so much easier and smooth.

Ordered this because of the reviews and am SUPERRRR DISAPPOINTED. First of all I tried reviewing it and posting video but they wouldn’t post it ! Ha funny. Anyways I’ll leave another review later. Brush came USED! With the bristles all messed up and glue or acrylic stuck in the brush. ! I’ve already been waiting for forever and now I have to wait even longer for a replacement. That just goes to show what kind of people are behind this business. Also they’ve seen my reviews and like any normal de
Will be ordering again...maybe a bigger size...I bought a size 10...it’s good quality...but I think the bigger the brush...the better your nail will look

It’s okay to get you started! It does seem like the acrylic doesn’t want to stick to the brush  but you’ll have to keep working with it! I’m a beginner as well and I had to keep working with it. Buttttttt I do recommend for beginners bc if the price & it gives you a feel of what to expect and what not yo expect with other brushes you’ll use in the future . Alsoooooo keeping it in its original container also helps keep the brush from hardening:)
it looked like it was used when it came and the bristles are spread out. and doesnt come together even when in contact with monomer. horrible, and absorbs too much liquid. and it wastes it.

reviews.t: The best nail brush on Amazon
reviews.x: I absolutely love this brush!! It's a #8 so it's a little smaller than what you would see in the salon, that being said it makes it easier to work with for beginners!
Complete garbage it was my first time ever using this brush and it was garbage don’t waste your money all your paying for is the look of the rush not quality
Decent nail brush, but make sure you use nail brush cleaner.
Works really well! I’m new to nails so I can’t just waste money and this definitely is worth it!
This is a real nice brush and very good looking too.

reviews.t: Not sure if it's authentic kolinsky!
reviews.x: This kolinsky brush is worth trying out! I like the long handle with slanted tip to help scrape off any side residue of polish or even acrylic powder before it drys for us beginners lol! The size seems to be true! Not short teeny tiny bristles! The hair is soft but I don't feel it's 100% pure kolinsky! It's just not as soft or even high quality as my other truly true kolinskys from MelodieSusie!!!!

I LOVE THIS BRUSH! I am definitely buying another one. I have bought a few other brushes a little more expensive and this one is better! UPDATE: so the brush is ok, I'm used a few times and not I have to get a new one. The bristles do not stay in place. It was ok when I first got it but now I would say be careful make sure you have a back up brush

reviews.t: Smooth and pretty but cheap quality
reviews.x: It does make for a smooth application so I really like it for that reason. And I love that it's not wood. However, I have already lost a few bristles which is not good for an acrylic brush. My cheaper ones are still going strong and I've had them much longer and used a lot more. So that could be worked on.

This is a beautiful arylic brush. Although it does not hold shape and sheds. On the other hand if you take care of this brush after the first useage. This brush could become a winner, but that's not how seller's should sale product. It should be close to the best out of the package

So far I have like 5 acrylic brushes I just started doing my nails in late April I have a few size 8 a few size 10 and one size 12 and this size 10 brush is my favorite brush seems to work best and acrylic doesn’t seem to get stuck in it like I have had with a few other brushes

I am a beginner nail tech and this brush is amazing. It is not too big and not too small it’s a perfect size for the acrylic application. It picks up the powder very nicely and holds a good amount of monomer. And the brush is really cute it looks very expensive.

I loved this Brush. It was great for me being a beginner in nails. I saw a few bad reviews saying it wasn’t good quality or that it came damaged but mine came perfect. I’ve used it a few times and it’s great. The price is also great so you can’t beat it!!

reviews.t: Good value for money and very functional and pretty!
reviews.x: Bought as a Christmas gift for my sister in law who loves to do her own acrylic nails. She loves it.  The design is pretty, the brush itself has good weight without being too heavy and the brush tip works well for acrylic powder! A great buy overall.

I am highly dissatisfied. The brush head immediately fell off and continued to fall apart. The bristles looked as if the brush was already used. You definitely get poor quality for what the price of this brush is. I would not recommend this brush.

reviews.t: Does Well for the Price Point
reviews.x: Not the softest bristled brush I've ever used but maybe that will come with the number of uses. Other than that I had no issue with monomer retention or patting the acrylic down down onto the nail. Maybe better for someone that is learning.

The brush hairs came split already before I was even able to use it . I clipped them and used the brush as it was and after my first use doing one set of nails THEY SPLIT AGAIN!!! Worst brush I’ve ever used and will never ever buy again

Really disappointed in this brush. It started to fray after the FIRST use and its all misshapen. My wish brushes have held up longer than this one. I’m so mad I spent all this money on this one and my cheaper ones are way better.

Love this I am a beginner and it works great for me and easy to clean if you have the correct brush cleaner and maintains its shape. It should last for a long time if you clean after every use. Wonderful I would recommend.

at first I loved it and after one use, the brush started falling apart, it made it so hard to apply the acrylic properly and I was so frustrated. Just going to buy an expensive brush instead, save me the headache

claims.text: Many reviewers love this brush and say it makes acrylic application easier and smoother, especially for beginners.
Several reviewers report quality problems, including bristles that shed, spread out, or lose their shape.
Some reviewers received a brush that appeared used, with messed-up bristles or acrylic/glue stuck in it.
Reviewers praise the brush's value and appearance, calling it good quality and nice-looking for the price.
A few reviewers note the brush absorbs too much liquid or that acrylic doesn't stick well to it.
